lang.label: Language
lang.name: English
page.firstApprovedNote: This is the scope as you first approved it. The agreement now, with approved change orders, is below.
doc.fxFixed: The rate is fixed by this scope.
decide.heading: Does everything
decide.linkOpenUntil: This link stays open until {date}. After that, ask the creator for a new one.
decide.intro: Review the deliverables, fee, and working terms. Approve this version or describe what needs to change.
decide.name: Your name
decide.commentKept: What you type here is kept on this device until your decision is saved.
decide.consent: I have reviewed version {version}, including its fee, deliverables, and revision allowance.
decide.unavailable: We couldn’t record your decision just now, and nothing was saved. The problem is on our side, not with your answer. Wait a moment and try again, or let the sender know.
decide.retryIn: You can try again in {seconds} seconds.
decide.tellSubject: I couldn’t record my decision on version {version}
decide.tellBody: Hello, I tried to record my decision on version {version} of the scope, but the review page couldn’t save it. Here is the link: {link}
decide.needsCode: Approve becomes available after you confirm the code above.
decide.errName: Enter your name to record this decision.
decide.errConsent: Confirm that you reviewed this version before recording a decision.
decide.errCodeEmail: Confirm your email with the code first.
decide.errCodePhone: Confirm your phone number with the code first.
decide.fineCodeEmail: Your email is confirmed with a one-time code; your name is recorded as entered.
decide.fineCodePhone: Your phone number is confirmed with a one-time code; your name is recorded as entered.
decide.fineNoCode: Your name is recorded as entered. This link does not check who you are.
decide.fineMoney: Approving or requesting changes does not charge you. If the scope asks for a deposit, it is paid separately on this page after you approve, through Razorpay or Stripe when online payment is set up.
replaced.heading: This version has been replaced
replaced.body: This is the original record for version {version}. Ask the creator for the latest review link before making a decision.
newer.title: A newer version of this scope exists
newer.body: Version {version} was shared after this one, so a decision can no longer be recorded here.
newer.ask: Ask the person who sent you this link for the new one.
newer.kept: Your comment is kept below, so you can copy it into the new version.
success.title: Approved. Thank you.
success.body: Your approval of version {version} is saved. You and the creator now have the same record.
success.payDepositHelp: The creator asked for a deposit on signature. You can pay it below.
success.nothing: Nothing else is needed from you right now. Keep your receipt; the creator will be in touch about the work.
changes.title: Changes requested
changes.body: The creator has your comments and will send an updated version.
receipt.title: Your receipt
receipt.body: Scopeflow sealed this decision. Download the PDF receipt below and keep it: its record check code and QR code let anyone check later that the approved scope was not changed.
decided.baselineNote: This decision applies to version {version}. It stays fixed. Approved change orders below update the agreement; the creator may also issue a new version.
deposit.title: Deposit
deposit.covered: Deposit covered: the creator has recorded {amount} in payments. Details are in the record below.
deposit.asks: This scope asks for a {pct}% deposit on signature:
deposit.offline: Pay it to the creator the way you agreed. Online payment is not available for this scope.
deposit.help: Opens the payment provider’s secure checkout. Approving did not charge you; this payment is separate.
deposit.submitted: {label}: payment submitted. It shows here once the payment provider confirms it.
deposit.returnOk: Payment completed. It appears on the record once the payment provider confirms it, usually within a minute.
invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.note: Paid status follows the payments on the record below. If you have paid and it is not shown yet, the creator records it when the money arrives.
agreement.title: Current agreement
agreement.intro: Version {version} is the approved starting point. Change orders need your approval before they apply. The creator also records revision rounds, received inputs, delivery shifts, payments and goodwill here.
now.title: Agreement now
now.sub: Approved scope plus every change order you approved, with tax.
chip.unsealed: Record unchanged · saved before sealing was on
check.ok: Record check code {code} covers {count} entries. Every entry is linked to the one before it and to the approved scope, so a later edit to any of them would change this code.
check.okOne: Record check code {code} covers 1 entry. It is linked to the approved scope, so a later edit would change this code.
check.sealed: Every entry and the approval carry Scopeflow seals that were checked in your browser.
check.unsealed: Some entries were saved before sealing was turned on.
check.keep: Save or print this page to keep a copy.
check.failedAsk: Ask the creator about it before approving anything further.
check.browserFail: This browser could not run the check.
co.name: Your name
co.consent: I have reviewed CO-{seq}, including its effect on the fee and timeline.
co.errWait: Wait for the record check to pass before recording a decision.
co.errName: Enter your name to record this decision.
co.errConsent: Confirm that you reviewed this change before approving.
co.errWhy: Please say why, so the creator can follow up.
co.errCode: Confirm your email with the code first.
co.otpOne: a decision on this change order
closed.revoked.title: This link is closed for new changes
closed.revoked.body: The creator closed this link for new changes. Your record stays here: you can still read it and download your receipt, statement and invoices.
closed.account.title: The creator closed their Scopeflow account
closed.account.body: This record is kept for you, read-only. Download your receipt and invoices to keep your own copy.
closed.account.until: This record is kept for you until {date}.
closed.noActions: This link is read-only, so no new decisions or payments can be made here.
problem.notFound.title: This link isn’t working
problem.notFound.body: The link may have been typed or copied wrongly, replaced by a newer link, or withdrawn by the person who sent it.
problem.expired.title: This link has expired
problem.expired.body: This review link stopped working on {date}.
problem.expired.bodyNoDate: This review link has stopped working.
problem.ask: Ask the person who sent it for a new link.
problem.mailBody: Hello, the review link you sent me no longer works. Could you send a new one? Thank you.
problem.home: Go to the Scopeflow home page
problem.check: Check a receipt you already have
problem.unavailable.title: We couldn’t load this page
problem.unavailable.body: Something went wrong on our side or with the connection. Your record is safe.
notice.title: What this page records
notice.body: When you approve, request changes or decide a change order, we record your name, the time, your IP address and your browser to evidence the decision.
notice.days: Your IP address and browser details are kept for {days} days, then removed; the decision itself stays on the record.
notice.noDays: Your IP address and browser details are kept while the creator keeps this project, unless they set a shorter period.
glossary.title: Words on this page
glossary.recordCheck: Record check: a code worked out from the record. If anything in the record changed, the code would change too.
glossary.seal: Seal: Scopeflow’s electronic stamp on the record, which shows the record came from Scopeflow unchanged.
glossary.co: Change order: a priced change to the agreed scope. It applies only after you approve it.
evidence.title: Record of this decision
evidence.honest: Approved by whoever held this link, code-verified to a masked address.
evidence.ownerSession: Decided while the creator was signed in on this browser.
